extracted.intended_audience: readers of historical fiction; general book-buying public; literary researchers
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluative qualities and selling-points for historical novels (as presented in publisher blurbs and back-matter): what makes a historical romance/novel successful or noteworthy. The page is a complete historical novel with publisher blurbs that articulate criteria for strong historical fiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vivid coloring and picturesque treatment
rubrics_metrics.description: “Vivid coloring and picturesque treatment are always features of Miss Bowen’s work.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a positive attribute in the blurb: signals strong sensory, visual description and atmospheric detail as a hallmark of quality in historical fiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Careful attention to historical detail / historical research
rubrics_metrics.description: “Miss Bowen has put an ardor of historical research into her work.... Of decided historical and dramatic interest.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Blurb stresses and treats rigorous historical research/accuracy as a key criterion: factual grounding and period detail increase dramatic interest and authenticity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelist’s skill in vivid character delineation
rubrics_metrics.description: “the novelist’s skill in vivid character delineation.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Praise emphasizes clear, lively, and convincing characterization—drawing historical figures with dignity and charm—so character depiction is a central quality measure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Power to create historical atmosphere
rubrics_metrics.description: “She has no living equal in the art of creating historical atmosphere.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ability to evoke the look, feel, and social ambience of a historical period is highlighted as a primary evaluative standard for historical novels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brilliancy / vividness of descriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: “The brilliancy of her descriptions render her book a very remarkable piece of work.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Striking, evocative descriptive passages that bring scenes and settings to life are presented as a criterion of excellence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blend of historian’s detail and novelist’s dramatic skill
rubrics_metrics.description: “The author develops her novel with an art that is a potent blend of the historian’s careful attention to detail and the novelist’s skill in vivid character delineation.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Successful historical fiction balances meticulous factual detail with narrative and character craft; both historianly research and novelist’s imagination are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imaginative power / ‘storehouse of stimulating imagination’
rubrics_metrics.description: “This series ... is a storehouse of stimulating imagination to any reader who has the slightest historical instinct.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Imaginative reconstructions and original, evocative storytelling that stimulate the reader’s historical imagination are valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoidance of common faults of historical novels
rubrics_metrics.description: “None of the usual charges against historical novels can be made against Marjorie Bowen’s.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied criterion: the novel avoids clichéd faults (inaccuracy, anachronism, melodrama, thin characterization) typically leveled at lesser historical fiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gorgeous coloring, quaint incident, plotting and love-making
rubrics_metrics.description: “Plunges the reader with its first lines into a fascinating life full of gorgeous coloring, quaint incident, plotting and love-making.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positive assessment highlights rich imagery, memorable incidents, strong plotting, and romantic elements as desirable components of engaging historical narratives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective distribution of dialogue and narrative; use of detail; assured style
rubrics_metrics.description: “The author distributes dialogue and narrative in readable proportion, he understands the effective use of detail and has an uncommon facility in description, and he writes in an easy, assured style with a dash of wit.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Critique identifies pacing and balance between dialogue and exposition, judicious selection of detail, confident prose style, and tasteful wit as concrete stylistic criteria for quality fiction.
